calls.title: Ashely / Alyssa 1:1
calls.summary: The meeting evaluated the AI World event, which received a B grade and had the smallest buy-in level, indicating expectations for better ROI in future events. A Product Hunt post is set to be written by Alyssa and published by Graham. Discussions included the kickoff of the AI onboarding wizard with Omar and Scott to align the MVP, alongside Alyssa testing the Post Hog onboarding process. On documentation, ongoing migration with Mintlify involves fixing styles and engineering reviews. Video tutorials have been created, and a script retake for skills videos was requested. User engagement strategies included addressing inactivity in the visual editor Slack channel and proposing outreach to check user experience two weeks post-access. Lastly, updates on documentation migration were assigned to Alyssa, and in-app AI chat promotion was discussed.
calls.keywords: AI onboarding, Product Hunt post, docs migration, Mintlify, visual editor videos, early access engagement
